description: Fixed 275-position HC depletion corpus referencing original games and optional submitted-turn cutoffs; 20 default cases and 255 expanded cases.
selection: All root PGNs at quarter, half, three-quarter, penultimate, final; all non-TurnZero online variants plus 48 TurnZero files selected by SHA256 paired-expanded-v1:filename, at half, three-quarter, penultimate; original count controls final. Duplicate full historical states deduplicated.
default_selection: Retain the four existing controls and choose 16 additional positions by count, timeline structure, variant and diagnostic coverage; include costly complete spaces and capped large spaces, rather than selecting only speedup examples.
enumeration: Fully enumerate known spaces up to 200000 actions; otherwise require more than 50000 actions and stop at 50001. Prefixes run independently.
state_hash: SHA256 of Python str(board_size), str(promotion_options), str(initial timeline metadata) and complete historical FEN concatenated, recorded at corpus selection. The file SHA256 values identify the original source PGNs; at selects a submitted main-line turn, and omission selects the final position.
